import statistics

# July 1969 - July 1970 (12 months, all from August bulletin)
jul69_jul70 = [393, 348, 321, 404, 274, 346, 381, 383, 427, 366, 367, 446]
print('July 1969 - July 1970:', jul69_jul70)

median1 = statistics.median(jul69_jul70)
print('Median:', median1)

# August 1969 - August 1970 (13 months, all from September bulletin)
aug69_aug70 = [348, 321, 404, 274, 346, 381, 383, 427, 366, 367, 446, 393, 388]

print('Median:', median2)

print('As whole number:', round(max(median1, median2)))
